topic: The Pi-Collision Paradox: Why Bouncing Blocks Count Digits of Pi
target_audience: University students (Physics/Math) or curious high schoolers

sections.title: The Hook: A Paradoxical Counting Puzzle
lecture_lines: Tiny block collides with a massive block.
The number of bounces is surprisingly huge.
Mass ratios unlock the digits of Pi.
animations: Create two rectangles on a plane (M1=1, M2=10^2k). Color #FFFFFF. Labels M1, M2.
Visualize elastic collision with velocity vector arrows. Color #FF00FF.
Change M2 color to #FFFF00 for emphasis as it hits M1.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Elastic Collision & Conservation
lecture_lines: Momentum and energy are perfectly conserved.
We map velocity states on a plane.
animations: Represent masses as circles M1, M2. Color #00FFFF. Labels M1, M2.
Animate conservation of momentum equation text. Color #00FF00.
Show velocity vectors flipping after collision. Color #FF8000.

sections.title: The Geometry of Collisions: The Phase Space Arc
lecture_lines: Energy forms an ellipse in phase space.
Collisions are boundary reflections in a slice.
Trajectory arcs define the bounce count.
animations: Plot trajectory of velocity (v1, v2) in phase space. Color #FFFFFF.
Draw arc representing constant energy. Color #FF00FF.
Mark collision points on arc. Color #FFFF00. Size 0.5.
Fade out auxiliary lines, focus on final arc shape. Color #00FF00.

sections.title: The Reveal: Linking Physics to Pi
lecture_lines: Mass ratio shrinks the pie-slice angle.
The trajectory unrolls along a circular arc.
It physically computes digits of Pi.
animations: Show trajectory arc segment length relative to Pi. Color #FF00FF.
Demonstrate geometric mapping to sector angle. Color #FFFF00.
Display collision count digits as Pi digits. Color #00FFFF.
Glow the final Pi result. Color #FFFFFF.

sections.title: Summary & Synthesis
lecture_lines: Complex dynamics reveal hidden mathematical constants.
Simple collisions map to deep numbers.
animations: Summarize physics chain: Mass ratio to collisions to Pi. Color #FFFFFF.
Fade out objects, leave the final equation: Collisions = Pi digits. Color #FF00FF.
